alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Non-optimal fill level feedback screen
text: Feedback for a non-optimal fill level utilises cold colours and negative messaging to evoke a willingness to improve within the user.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Optimal fill level feedback screen
text: Feedback for an optimal fill level utilises warm colours and very positive messaging to encourage the user to repeat this behaviour.

alt: Mockup of the Lausha App - Scoring explanation screen
text: Further feedback can be viewed by the user for transparency and to avoid confusion and frustration about the scoring system.
